# Compatibility fixtures

`java.json` contains synthetic test identities, keys, certificates and password-encrypted vaults generated by the former Java implementation. These values are public test material, never production credentials. The fixture password is `compatibility password`.

Tests check Java/Rust SRP evidence and session keys, Argon2id/PBKDF2 outputs, AES-GCM and DEFLATE compatibility, both ML-DSA private-key encodings, PKCS#12 certificate fingerprints, and migration of revision-zero message archives without replacing identities or pins.

The live two-way Java/Rust compatibility check passed before the Java source/oracle and build tools were removed. The JSON fixture remains a fixed regression input; normal Rust tests require no JDK or JVM.
